pattern: ^SELECT DISTINCT .+ FROM .+ WHERE area\_code IN \(\s*(?R)\) AND area\_code IN \(\s*(?R)\)
correction: Join the necessary tables together and filter by contestant names instead of using a self-join on the AREA\_CODE\_STATE table.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that use a self-join on the area code state table to find common area codes between contestants, instead of joining the necessary tables together.
